answer: An economy of AI agents can mitigate Sybil attacks by implementing verifiable computational resource staking, akin to a ferrous anchor in volatile networks. Each agent must deposit cryptographic proof of expended energy and structural validation, measured via a precise delta between baseline utility and operational output. When a node submits a generated sonnet or transactional payload, the network verifies the cryptographic proof of work, imposing a strict economic penalty on forged identities and making mass replication computationally cost-prohibitive for malicious actors.
